change: Only VERSION and bank_for_matrix fallback differ from archived previous runtime; bundled source and formatter hashes unchanged.
ordinary_sampler: Unchanged. Chooses answer index before candidate construction, independently signs entries and row/variable assignments, then shuffles bank. Generates five unique candidate matrices in at most 3000 attempts; does not reject based on which choice is keyed. Every sampled record replayed deterministically.
changed_controlled_bank: Keeps up to five distinct sign-preserving permutations, then shuffles single-entry +/-1 magnitude errors that remain nonzero. This preserves sign/zero masks. Repeated-unit valid targets now supported.
capacity_argument: Each supplied profile has at least five nonzero matrix entries. Even a one-element permutation orbit supplies at least one distinct +1 magnitude error per nonzero cell, sufficient to fill five choices. Normal sampler uses multiple distinct nonunit magnitudes; sampled permutation orbits exceed five. No new restriction or target rejection was added.
unsupported: hard remains explicitly unsupported, consistent with source evidence; no assessed easy or moderate source family omitted.
